name: LightRAG
author: BizarHarness
description: LightRAG server integration — graph-based RAG for the Bizar dashboard. Auto-starts a LightRAG HTTP server (lightrag-hku[api] Python package) and exposes it as a dashboard view with document insert + query UI. v1.0.0 ships a mod instructions skill that teaches agents to query the knowledge graph for cross-document questions before re-reading source files.

view.label: LightRAG
view.description: Graph-based RAG server. Insert documents, query the knowledge graph.

host.description: Host the LightRAG server binds to.

port.description: Port the LightRAG server binds to.

autoStart.description: If true, auto-start the LightRAG server when the mod loads.

workingDir.description: Working directory for the LightRAG server (data persisted here).

llmModel.description: LLM model to use for entity-relation extraction and query synthesis. Uses the opencode provider format.

embeddingModel.description: Embedding model. Must be set before indexing.
